messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] infra.runtime.latency_slo_breach service=runtime-streaming p99=3.4s p95=1.1s SLO=800ms — paging #eng-oncall

sre-ash: acknowledging. i'm pulling dashboards and tail traces now.

ml-zoe: quick glance — large spike started ~16:03 UTC. correlated with continuous-batcher traffic: batch occupancy rate jumped and queue wait times spiked. looks like mixed-sequence amplification (short vs long).

platform-paul: we had a scheduler tweak merged in 2.8.0 at 15:50 that changed batch fill threshold and enabled larger batch consolidation for streaming. rollout completed at 16:00.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: continuous-batcher v2.8.0 rolled out to runtime cluster 15:58 -> full (us-west-2/us-east-1).

ml-zoe: repro on perf-staging: alternating seq lengths (10 / 900) into streaming lane causes p99 to jump from ~600ms -> ~3s. snippet:
```python
# simplified load script
for _ in range(1000):
  seq = 900 if random.random() < 0.05 else 10
  send_stream_request(seq_len=seq)
```
observed: median queue_wait=80ms, p95 queue_wait=850ms, p99 queue_wait=2.8s.

sre-ash: traces show KV cache churn — large sequences evict per-request KV entries causing later short requests to wait on cache rebuild + batch padding increases tokens processed per batch.

cs-marc: customer impact: two enterprise customers reported "stream stutter" and partial responses between 16:05-16:20. escalated to SEs, notifying them now.

eng-maya: grabbing flamegraphs and scheduler logs. suspect heuristics that try to maximize throughput may be harming latency SLO for streaming.

sre-ash: mitigation options (fast -> slower):
  1) toggle runtime flag to enforce strict streaming batch caps (reduce max_batch_tokens) 
  2) enable mixed-seqlen preemption (shed long sequences when short-latency required)
  3) rollback v2.8.0 scheduler changes
  4) route VIP customers to dedicated pool while we fix

platform-paul: we can flip a feature-flag for streaming_batch[MAX_BYTES]=150000 and enable BATCH_PREEMPTIVE=true via config service. canary change takes ~30s.

ops-bot: runbook snippet for quick change:
```bash
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/flags 
 -d '{"service":"continuous-batcher","flags":{"streaming_max_bytes":"150000","streaming_preempt":"true"}}' 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

sre-ash: applying to canary now. watching p99 on canary subset.

(90s pass)

sre-ash: canary p99 dropped 3.4s -> 0.95s, p95 down to 420ms. good signal. promoting change to 50% rollout.

ml-zoe: also pushing a short-term scheduler tweak: lower batch_fill_timeout for streaming to 12ms to reduce padding.

platform-paul: starting 50% rollout. rollback plan: if p99 > 1.5s for >2 min, rollback to v2.7.x and disable the scheduler consolidation flag.

cs-marc: notified affected customers with ETA ~10-15m. they're accepting temporary mitigation. want confirmation when full rollout done.

eng-maya: logs show KV eviction rate dropped after canary change which matches improvement. will open a follow-up ticket to adjust scheduler heuristics to consider seq_len variance.

sre-ash: rolling to 100% now. monitoring overall p99/p95 and tail tokens.

(3 minutes pass)

sre-ash: metrics stable: global p99=0.88s p95=360ms. SLO breach cleared. closing the immediate paging.

ml-zoe: postmortem action items:
  - revert the consolidation heuristic in 2.8.0 and rework to be seq_len-aware (owner: ml infra)
  - add synthetic mixed-seq test to CI (owner: perf)
  - improve KV cache eviction metrics and set alerting thresholds (owner: runtime)
  - runbook update: pref-presets for streaming vs batch workloads (owner: oncall docs)

platform-paul: i'll schedule a targeted rollback for the consolidation flag in the next dev cycle; preferring code fix over permanent flag.

cs-marc: i filed customer followups and will send confirmation when issue fully resolved for them.

eng-maya: handing off to night oncall @sre-nick with summary: SLO breach at 16:03 caused by v2.8.0 batching consolidation, mitigated by config caps + preemptive shedding. watch for regression around KV eviction, and don't promote v2.8.0 consolidation without seq_len-aware logic.

sre-ash: handing off: all alerts silenced, playbook changes made in canary & prod, postmortem ticket created (#INC-4721). last_message: i've annotated traces and saved relevant logs to /var/logs/incidents/3234567890/ for team review.
